name: Shared remembered device sessions
audience: Trusted application backends, including desktop and mobile APIs
base_url: Existing stellar-user.base_url configuration; endpoint paths belong to the SDK
authentication: Existing server-side service authentication; never embed service credentials in desktop, iOS, Android or browser apps

operations.loginRememberedSession: Primary credentials -> scoped access plus renewal credential
operations.registerRememberedSession: Existing registration policy -> scoped access plus renewal credential
operations.rememberScopedSession: Retired: throws without network access; fresh primary authentication required
operations.rememberAnonymousSession: Compatibility enrollment for a verified anonymous VPN account; calling backend verifies ownership
operations.inspectDeviceSession: Validate scoped access and obtain its account identity
operations.revokeDeviceSession: Revoke only the supplied device session
operations.listDeviceSessions: Valid renewal credential -> owner-only sanitized sessions, 50 per page and optional after cursor
operations.revokeOwnedDeviceSession: Valid renewal credential plus session ID -> revoke one session owned by the authenticated account; foreign/missing IDs return the same 404

lifetimes.renewal: No idle or absolute expiry; explicit revocation and account/authentication changes still apply

client_storage: Each native client stores its own renewal credential in protected OS storage. The consuming API never receives user-selected account IDs, scopes or token lifetimes.
isolation: Mobile and desktop sessions use the same service with separate device credentials; revoking one must preserve the other.
legacy: UserService session methods are unchanged. DesktopSessionClient is a deprecated compatibility facade over DeviceSessionClient.
rollout: Review source, release SDK, approve exact dependency/runtime, apply User API migration and enable STELLAR_DEVICE_SESSIONS_ENABLED. Each consuming backend opts in separately.
